note: Snapshot of the open SonarCloud findings under scripts/terminfo*, queried read-only from the public SonarCloud API. Leads from the handoff (15 new issues, cognitive-complexity findings, one regex flag) are reconciled against it; this snapshot, not the handoff, is the authority. Re-run the queries in 2026-11-09-sonar-audit.md to refresh.

source.mainQualityGate: ERROR (new_reliability_rating 3, new_security_rating 3; the only recent bug is csharpsquid:S3168 in src/Ntilde.App, outside the terminfo pipeline)

S5843.name: Regular expressions should not be too complicated
S5843.note: Linear: an anchored alternation of fixed literals with no quantifier or nested group (complexity 33 counts alternatives, not backtracking). Input is request.kind, a string chosen by the parent-owned worker from compiled-in prefixes and sent over the token-authenticated owner socket. Not changed: the runner is the trusted launcher script whose bytes are part of the measured source graph and it cannot be imported by a test. Guarded instead by scripts/terminfo/owned-runner-dispatch.test.mjs (no quantifier, no nested group, accepted set, near-miss rejection, linear time on 8 MB inputs). Residual: a readability smell; follow-up is a table-driven dispatch together with the next runner change.

S8786.name: Regular expressions should not cause non-linear backtracking
S8786.note: Genuine, bounded: /^(.*?)(\d+)$/ in compactLines retries the digit run from every lazy start (quadratic on digit-rich lines). Reachable from App-observed viewport and history text, bounded by the contract limits (at most 256 columns by 128 rows), so worst case was milliseconds, not a hang. Replaced by splitTrailingNumber, a linear scan with identical results (including the line-terminator refusal of `.`), proven by an equivalence test against the former expression and by maximum-admitted and million-character cases. Output of every retained publication is unchanged.

S3415.name: Assertion arguments should be passed in the correct order
S3415.note: Test-only: two assertions had literal and measured value swapped. Swapped; no behavior change.

S2681.name: Multiline blocks should be enclosed in curly braces
S2681.note: scrollback-model.mjs:75 `if (first === 2) { ...; for (...) stmt; return; }`: the return is outside the loop but inside the braces of the if, as intended. False positive from the single-line layout.

S2310.name: Loop counters should not be assigned within the loop body
S2310.note: compactLines advances `index` past the lines it has just folded into one entry; the skip is the algorithm and is covered by the numbered-run tests.

S9382.name: Promises should not be awaited sequentially in a loop
S9382.note: The collectors drive one disposable App through an ordered measurement protocol; each step depends on the previous reply, so the awaits must stay sequential. Parallelizing would break determinism and the shared desktop lock.

S3776.name: Cognitive Complexity of functions should not be too high
S3776.note: Maintainability only. These are plan builders, graders and receipt validators whose output is byte-compared against frozen publications; refactoring them is a behavior-risk change to evidence validation with no defect behind it. Deferred to a dedicated refactor that can prove byte-identical reports; the validation checks must not be relaxed to lower the score.

S3358.name: Ternary operators should not be nested
S3358.note: Cosmetic. The modules are in the measured owned-source graph; mass restyling changes the next run's source digests for no behavioral gain. Fold into the same follow-up as S3776.

S1128.name: Unnecessary imports should be removed
S1128.note: Import edges are part of the owned-source graph (literalImports scan and inventory consistency); removing them is a graph change that needs its own policy decision, not a drive-by. No runtime effect.

S7763.name: Re-exports should use "export...from" syntax
S7763.note: Cosmetic; `export … from` does not create a local binding and several of these modules also use the name locally, so each needs individual review.

S7765.name: Existence checks should use ".includes()" instead of ".indexOf()" or ".lastIndexOf()"

S7780.name: String literals with escaped backslashes should use String.raw
S7780.note: Cosmetic; the escaped strings are in collector-patching code that is digest-pinned.

S4624.name: Template literals should not be nested

S107.name: Functions should not have too many parameters

S7737.name: Objects should not be used as default parameters

S7744.name: Unnecessary fallback objects should not be used when spreading in object literals

S7723.name: Built-in constructors should be called consistently with or without "new"

S7758.name: Unicode-aware string methods should be used for proper character handling
S7758.note: scrollback-model.mjs builds the ESC byte with String.fromCharCode(0x1b); a BMP control character, so the result is identical.

S7778.name: Multiple consecutive calls to methods that accept multiple arguments should be combined
